name: Bingles' Wrench
summary: In the Loch, Bingles' Wrench is missing with the pilot's other tools. Troggs took it after Bingles Blastenheimer crash-landed his flying machine.

sections.title: Salvage on the Islands
sections.body:
Bingles Blastenheimer survived when his gyrocopter crashed into the Loch. Then the troggs raided the crash site on the small northern islands. They took his specialized supplies and scattered his tools among buckets in their camps.

Bingles' Wrench is one of three critical hand tools, alongside his high-yield Blastencapper explosives. Without the wrench, Bingles cannot repair his downed gyrocopter. His planned aerial offensive to aid the exiled gnomes fighting to reclaim Gnomeregan must wait.

faq.q: Who does this wrench belong to?
faq.answer: The wrench belongs to Bingles Blastenheimer, an eccentric gnome pilot whose gyrocopter crashed into the Loch.

faq.q: Why is the wrench so important to Bingles?
aliases: why does bingles need his wrench
faq.answer: Bingles needs his specialized tools to repair his damaged flying machine and arm his explosive payload for an aerial assault against the troggs and leper gnomes occupying Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Where did the wrench end up after the crash?
faq.answer: Local troggs scavenged the wrench and stashed it in one of Bingles' stolen toolbuckets among their camps on the northern islands of the Loch.

faq.q: What else was stolen along with the wrench?
faq.answer: The troggs also took Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' Hammer, and his experimental Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives.

angles.text: As a gnome, every recovered tool brings the resistance closer to taking the fight back to Gnomeregan's irradiated halls.
As an engineer, you know a craftsman without a custom wrench is grounded, especially with troggs scavenging nearby.
